MP Congress Shifts 'Shakti Pradarshan' and 'Vote Rakshak Abhiyan' to Jabalpur

The Madhya Pradesh Congress has decided to hold its 'Shakti Pradarshan' (show of strength) in Jabalpur instead of Bhopal. The party will also launch its 'Vote Rakshak Abhiyan' (voter protection campaign) on November 26, which will commence from Jabalpur.
